title: ECoG_HB_02: hybrid-density ECoG high-gamma features with synchronised speech, one participant (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS repackaging of the single-participant Mendeley Data release ECoG_HB_02, containing hybrid-density ECoG high-gamma (70-150 Hz) envelope features at 125 Hz with synchronised speech audio. The participant is the only one from Chen et al. 2024 who consented to public release of neural and audio data. Raw voltage recordings were not released. The data comprise 372 word-production trials covering 51 distinct words, supporting neural speech decoding research.
methods_description: Per the original paper, ECoG was sampled at 2,048 Hz and downsampled to 512 Hz. Artefactual and epileptiform electrodes were rejected and a common average reference was applied. The Hilbert envelope of the high-gamma band (70-150 Hz) was computed, downsampled to 125 Hz, and z-scored per electrode to pre-stimulus silent baselines. In this derivative, the float64 feature matrix was converted to BrainVision float32 and all-zero columns were marked bad. Word trials were written as events, and the original HB02.h5 file was kept unchanged in sourcedata.
